problem.name: Hidden subgroups of nilpotency-class-two groups
problem.statement_latex: Given a uniquely encoded black-box group $G$ with $[G,G]\subseteq Z(G)$ and a function constant and distinct on cosets of $H\le G$, find generators of $H$. Complexity counts oracle queries and gates in the group encoding length.
problem.statement_text: Given a uniquely encoded black-box group $G$ with $[G,G]\subseteq Z(G)$ and a function constant and distinct on cosets of $H\le G$, find generators of $H$. Complexity counts oracle queries and gates in the group encoding length.

strength.description_latex: Exponential or subexponential to polynomial in the strongest stated regime.

quantum.headline_latex: $\operatorname{poly}(\log|G|)$ quantum time by Ivanyos--Sanselme--Santha, using commutator structure and reductions to abelian hidden-subgroup instances.
quantum.headline_text: $\operatorname{poly}(\log|G|)$ quantum time by Ivanyos–Sanselme–Santha, using commutator structure and reductions to abelian hidden-subgroup instances.

classical.headline_latex: Full coset-label acquisition takes $O(|G|)$ queries. Abelian subfamilies include Simon-type instances requiring $2^{\Omega(\log|G|)}$ classical queries.
